name: Judas Priest

whyMatters.en: Birmingham metal band that codified leather-and-studs image plus twin-guitar attack; British Steel (1980) and Painkiller (1990) bookend the classic peak.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰金属乐队：把皮衣铆钉形象与双吉他攻击法典化；British Steel（1980）与 Painkiller（1990）框住经典峰值。

note.en: British Steel short-riff single; twin-guitar hooks.
note.zh: British Steel 短 riff 单曲；双吉他钩子。

note.en: Travis double-bass + Halford highs; speed-metal peak.
note.zh: Travis 双底鼓 + Halford 高音；速度金属峰值。

note.en: US radio metal anthem; Screaming for Vengeance era.
note.zh: 美国电台金属圣歌；Screaming for Vengeance 时期。

interviewQuotes.text: Leather and studs became the uniform because it looked like the music sounded.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Rob Halford

lyricQuotes: There I was completely wasting, out of work and down
Faster than a bullet / Terrifying scream

shortBio.en: Halford + twin-guitar metal; British Steel to Painkiller classic peak.
shortBio.zh: Halford + 双吉他金属；British Steel 至 Painkiller 经典峰值。

body.en:
Formed 1969. Halford + Tipton/Downing twin leads define leather-metal image. British Steel shortens songs for radio; Painkiller (1990) with Travis revs speed.

Classic flag is Halford leather era through Painkiller.
body.zh:
1969 年组建。Halford + Tipton/Downing 双主音定义皮衣金属形象。British Steel 为电台缩短歌曲；与 Travis 的 Painkiller（1990）加速。

经典旗在 Halford 皮衣期至 Painkiller。

title.en: Twin guitar + leather as metal grammar
title.zh: 双吉他 + 皮衣当金属语法

body.en:
Priest codifies harmony leads, studs image, and motorcycle stage entry. Birmingham neighbors Sabbath; Priest chooses speed and polish over doom crawl.

Template Maiden and US metal both read.
body.zh:
Priest 把和声主音、铆钉形象与摩托车上场法典化。伯明翰邻居是 Sabbath；Priest 选速度与抛光而非 doom 爬行。

Maiden 与美国金属都读这模板。

body.en:
Peak: Halford / Tipton / Downing / Hill + (later) Travis. Ripper Owens 90s chapter is non-peak. Halford returns 2003.

Chronicle peak = leather Halford twin-guitar era through Painkiller.
body.zh:
巅峰：Halford / Tipton / Downing / Hill +（后）Travis。90 年代 Ripper Owens 章节非巅峰。Halford 2003 回归。

编年史巅峰 = 皮衣 Halford 双吉他期至 Painkiller。

title.en: Operatic highs, dual leads, iron bass
title.zh: 歌剧高音、双主音、铁贝斯

body.en:
Halford: wide vibrato, scream highs. Tipton/Downing: traded solos, harmony thirds. Hill: steady eighths. Travis: double-bass upgrade 1989.

Image and arrangement travel together.
body.zh:
Halford：宽颤音、尖叫高音。Tipton/Downing：交替独奏、三度和声。Hill：稳定八分。Travis：1989 双底鼓升级。

形象与编曲一起旅行。

title.zh: Breaking the Law：短 riff 电台

body.en:
British Steel. Two-minute crime riff, gang vocal hook. Metal without epic runtime.

Entry for listeners before Painkiller speed.
body.zh:
British Steel。两分钟犯罪 riff、合唱钩子。无史诗时长的金属。

Painkiller 速度前的听众入口。

body.en:
Travis intro, Halford top notes, twin-guitar carnage. 1990 statement after 80s polish.

Late classic peak track.
body.zh:
Travis 前奏、Halford 顶音、双吉他屠杀。80 年代抛光后的 1990 声明。

晚期经典峰值曲。

body.en:
Leather look and twin-lead grammar feed Maiden, Megadeth, and arena metal. Birmingham metal map: Sabbath doom, Priest speed/image.

Halford voice remains the citation.
body.zh:
皮衣外观与双主音语法喂养 Maiden、Megadeth 与体育场金属。伯明翰金属地图：Sabbath doom，Priest 速度/形象。

Halford 人声仍是引用。

note.en: British Steel through Painkiller peak window (Travis from 1989).
note.zh: British Steel 至 Painkiller 巅峰窗（Travis 自 1989）。
夹在 Halford 两期之间的 Jugulator / Demolition。

note.en: Short-riff metal single that fixed Priest radio face.
note.zh: 固定 Priest 电台脸的短 riff 金属单曲。

note.en: Leather + twin guitar as portable metal grammar.
note.zh: 皮衣 + 双吉他作为可移植金属语法。
